caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #4: WHO WON THIS TRADE? 🎮🏀 We traded Norman Powell in his career year for Gary Trent Jr. Who won?

• Mar 25, 2021: Powell to Portland for Gary Trent Jr. and Rodney Hood
• Powell with us that season: 19.6 PPG, a career high at the time
• Trent's first full season with us (2021-22): 18.3 PPG, 1.7 SPG
• Trent left for Milwaukee in 2024; Powell was named a 2026 All-Star with Miami
• Powell now, first 10 games in Chicago: 21.1 PPG

Powell or Trent: who won the trade?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #5 drops tomorrow night. Follow so you don't miss it.

beats.name: POWELL
beats.vo: Trent left for Milwaukee in twenty twenty-four. Powell kept climbing: an All-Star in twenty twenty-six, with Miami.
beats.dlg: 2024: TRENT TO MILWAUKEE.|2026: POWELL AN ALL-STAR.

beats.head: POWELL NOW
beats.name: POWELL
beats.vo: And now, at thirty-three, in Chicago: twenty-one point one a night in his first ten games.
beats.dlg: NOW 33, IN CHICAGO:|21.1 PPG IN 10 GAMES.

beats.head: THE VERDICT
beats.vo: Did we win this trade? W or L. Case five, tomorrow night.
beats.dlg: DID WE WIN THIS TRADE?|W OR L? CASE #5: TOMORROW NIGHT.

facts.claim: On March 25 (Mar 25), 2021, Portland acquired Powell from Toronto for Gary Trent Jr. and Rodney Hood; Powell was averaging a career-high 19.6 points at the time; drafted 46th overall (#46) in 2015 by Milwaukee, rights traded to Toronto; NBA champion 2019; named an NBA All-Star in 2026 in his only season with the Miami Heat; now with the Chicago Bulls (2026-present); born May 25, 1993, so 33 now and 27 at the trade

Trent Jr. (born January 18, 1999, so 22 at the trade, 5 years younger than Powell) was acquired by Toronto on March 25, 2021 for Norman Powell; with Toronto 2021-2024, so 2021-22 was his first full season with us; July 20, 2024 signed with the Milwaukee Bucks
